model_context: human and murine primary alveolar type II cells
reported_protection: Trolox contributes to Nrf2-mediated protection against oxidative stress, genotoxicity and inflammation in primary ATII cells.
readouts_relevant_to_PN: oxidative stress, genotoxicity, inflammation, cell injury
caveat_for_triage: Antioxidant protection could also reduce cancer stress/death; PC and antagonism must be measured.
source_title: Trolox contributes to Nrf2-mediated protection of human and murine primary alveolar type II cells from injury by cigarette smoke

reported_protection: Trolox protected rat thymocytes from peroxynitrite-mediated apoptosis.
caveat_for_triage: Non-human immune cell model; still useful as oxidative-apoptosis protection evidence.
source_title: Trolox inhibits peroxynitrite-mediated oxidative stress and apoptosis in rat thymocytes

reported_protection: Trolox can show concentration-dependent antioxidant/prooxidant behavior, so dose window matters.
caveat_for_triage: Must predefine non-toxic/protective dose before pair testing.
source_title: Concentration Dependence of the Antioxidant and Prooxidant Effects of Trolox

model_context: primary liver cells isolated from Atlantic salmon
reported_protection: Taurine attenuated apoptosis and supported mitochondrial integrity/respiration in primary liver cells.
caveat_for_triage: Primary-cell evidence exists but not human; translate as supportive PN prior only.
source_title: Taurine attenuates apoptosis in primary liver cells isolated from Atlantic salmon

stress_model: H2O2-induced oxidative stress and ER stress
reported_protection: Taurine protected cells against oxidative stress and suppressed ER stress associated with H2O2 exposure.
caveat_for_triage: PC12 is not a normal human primary model; useful for stress-pathway rationale.
source_title: Taurine protection of PC12 cells against endoplasmic reticulum stress induced by oxidative stress

reported_protection: Taurine protected osteocyte-like cells from oxidative-stress-induced cytotoxicity.
caveat_for_triage: Good normal-like cytoprotection signal, but tissue-specific and not cancer-comparator evidence.
source_title: Taurine, an osteocyte metabolite, protects against oxidative stress

model_context: individuals with type 2 diabetes; macro/microvascular endothelial function
reported_protection: Benfotiamine prevented macro- and microvascular endothelial dysfunction and oxidative stress after AGE-rich meal.
direct_human_normal_cell: human in vivo, not cell assay
caveat_for_triage: Strong normal-tissue protection rationale but not a direct in vitro normal-cell PN assay.
source_title: Benfotiamine prevents macro- and microvascular endothelial dysfunction and oxidative stress following a meal rich in advanced glycation end products

stress_model: oxidative-stress-induced NF-κB activation and bacterial endotoxin-induced inflammation
reported_protection: Benfotiamine suppressed oxidative-stress-induced NF-κB activation and prevented endotoxin-induced inflammation.
caveat_for_triage: Mechanistically relevant but not sufficient alone for normal-selectivity claim.
source_title: Protective role of benfotiamine, a fat soluble vitamin B1 analogue, in lipopolysaccharide-induced cytotoxic signals

reported_protection: A later randomized trial reported no significant reductions in plasma/urinary AGEs or endothelial dysfunction/low-grade inflammation markers versus placebo.
caveat_for_triage: Benfotiamine PN prior should be moderate, not assumed strong.
source_title: Effect of Benfotiamine on Advanced Glycation Endproducts and Markers of Endothelial Dysfunction and Inflammation

model_context: human epidermal keratinocytes and skin tissue
reported_protection: L-ergothioneine accumulated via OCTN1 and reduced ROS, DNA/protein/lipid damage, apoptotic response, and increased viability.
readouts_relevant_to_PN: ROS, DNA damage, protein/lipid damage, apoptosis, viability
caveat_for_triage: Strong PN prior, but its DNA-damage/apoptosis reduction creates PC-risk concern in cancer cells.
source_title: Skin cells and tissue are capable of using L-ergothioneine as an integral component of their antioxidant defense system

reported_protection: EGT was reported to protect against UV-induced oxidative stress through PI3K/Akt/Nrf2 signaling.
caveat_for_triage: Good skin-normal rationale; still needs normal-like model matched to assay design.
source_title: Ergothioneine Protects Against UV-Induced Oxidative Stress Through the PI3K/AKT/Nrf2 Signaling Pathway

reported_protection: EGT improved chondrocyte viability, lowered LDH activity in medium, and suppressed cell death after oxidative stress.
readouts_relevant_to_PN: viability, LDH, dead cell ratio, ROS/mitochondria
caveat_for_triage: Supports broad stress protection; tissue/context specificity remains.
source_title: Protective Effect of Ergothioneine against Oxidative Stress-Induced Chondrocyte Death
